theorems.name: Submission.dohr_eb_hsif_iteratedFDeriv_column_bounds
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (m : ℕ) (g : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] E)) (U : Set (Rn n)), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ m g U → ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U, (∀ k : Fin n, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z => g z (EuclideanSpace.single k (1 : ℝ))) x - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z => g z (EuclideanSpace.single k (1 : ℝ))) y‖ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m g x - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m g y‖) ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m g x - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m g y‖ ≤ ∑ k : Fin n, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z => g z (EuclideanSpace.single k (1 : ℝ))) x - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z => g z (EuclideanSpace.single k (1 : ℝ))) y‖
